summary: 072-approved Explore is reconverged into the existing three capability deltas. Product semantics and the package-bound atomic preparation seam remain unchanged; Proposal/Design/Tasks now replace the superseded native-Windows execution obligation with two explicit Linux-hosted semantic simulations. The unreadable-Guidance proof uses real low-privilege EACCES against the exact resolver, and the Git-mode proof uses core.filemode=false plus Git-index chmod with identical bytes and changed candidate identity. Native Windows execution is not required and no Windows/platform abstraction is introduced.
